lead.headline: A gunman kills six in Krakow's Main Market Square, and Poland calls it terrorism by a man fascinated with the far right
lead.byline: THE TIMES OF INDIA · THE GUARDIAN · 8 NOV
lead.short: A gunman in military-style fatigues drove into Krakow's crowded Main Market Square at about 3pm on Saturday and opened fire with an AR-15-style rifle, killing six people, including a British national, and wounding 15. Police shot and wounded the suspect, a 25-year-old believed to be a military school cadet. Poland's government called it an act of terror.

why.text: Poland is a NATO frontline state and a big tourist destination, and a far-right terror attack there will shape European security debates.

more: The man drove a black Subaru to several spots in the square, firing at a tram, pedestrians and two horses, police said. He wore a bulletproof vest, and more weapons and ammunition were found in his car. Police spokesperson Katarzyna Cisło said the man moved from place to place in the square, firing an automatic weapon at each stop.

Interior minister Marcin Kierwiński said the suspect held "very radical" and "ultranationalistic" views. "Everything indicates that he was fascinated by far-right ideologies," he said. Neighbours described a "polite, quiet guy" and said they had noticed nothing suspicious. The authorities have not officially named him. The attack comes as Poland is already in turmoil over a standoff at its top court.

facts.suspect: 25-year-old military school cadet, shot and wounded

seconds.headline: Israel's president asks Gadi Eisenkot, not Netanyahu, to form a government after he wins 67 recommendations
seconds.short: Israel's President Isaac Herzog on Saturday night gave opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot the first chance to form a government, after parties representing 67 members of the Knesset recommended him against 46 for Benjamin Netanyahu. Eisenkot, a former army chief, has 28 days, with a possible 14-day extension. "Now is the time to form a national emergency government," he wrote.

why.text: It is the clearest sign yet that Netanyahu's long hold on power may end, with consequences for the wars in Gaza and with Iran.

more: Netanyahu's Likud and its far-right and ultra-Orthodox allies won 53 of 120 seats, and Eisenkot's centrist Yashar and three other Jewish opposition parties 48. Two Arab-led alliances won an unprecedented 19, making them kingmakers. Eisenkot has said he could work with them if they meet conditions, including calling Hamas a terrorist group that must be destroyed.

Shortly before Herzog's announcement, Netanyahu called for a "national unity government" and warned against "hastily swearing in a government with terrorist supporters". He has alleged, without evidence, that some Arab countries interfered in the vote; the Central Elections Committee said there was "no basis" to claims the election's integrity was compromised.

update.new: Herzog picks Eisenkot to form a government.
update.front: For the first time in years, someone other than Netanyahu has the first chance to form Israel's government.

seconds.headline: Real Madrid beat 10-man Valencia 3-0 for an eighth straight win and draw level on points with Barcelona
seconds.short: Real Madrid won 3-0 at Valencia on Saturday, their eighth straight win in all competitions, to draw level on points with La Liga leaders Barcelona. Federico Valverde and Arda Güler scored in the first half and Kylian Mbappé added the third, scoring for the seventh match running. Barcelona visit third-placed Atlético Madrid on Sunday.

why.text: Madrid have caught Barcelona at the top going into the international break, without the suspended Vinícius.

more: Valverde scored from the edge of the box after Mbappé's free kick was blocked, and Güler doubled the lead in the 36th minute from Jude Bellingham's cut-back. Valencia goalkeeper Stole Dimitrievski kept the score down with saves from Güler, Mbappé and Bellingham before Mbappé finished from Güler's pass in the 75th minute.

Valencia's Gayà was sent off in the 79th minute for fouling Mbappé as he raced clear, and Thibaut Courtois made a diving save from Mayoral in the first half. The game stopped in the ninth minute in tribute to Tenerife's Jesús de Miguel. Vinícius Júnior served the last game of a four-match ban. Madrid next play Celta Vigo at home on 21 November.

update.new: A 3-0 win at Valencia puts Madrid level with Barcelona.
update.front: Madrid have caught Barcelona at the top of La Liga.

seconds.headline: India edge a rain-hit second ODI by four runs on DLS to lead 2-0, after Gurnoor Brar's 4 for 30
seconds.short: India beat New Zealand by four runs on the DLS method in a rain-hit second ODI in Wellington on Saturday to lead the five-match series 2-0. India were 113 for seven in 26 overs, chasing 134. Gurnoor Brar's 4 for 30 was the best by an Indian pacer in New Zealand since Javagal Srinath in 2003.

why.text: India can win the series in Hamilton on Tuesday, with a young pace attack doing the damage.

more: Brar took two wickets in a maiden, removing Tom Latham and Glenn Phillips with short balls to leave New Zealand 53 for five. Auqib Nabi took 2 for 31 and Anshul Kamboj 2 for 25, and Arshdeep Singh conceded only 16 in seven overs. Daryl Mitchell made 55 off 104 balls.

India's chase was hard work as New Zealand's pacers found movement and bounce: Jacob Duffy removed Shubman Gill for a first-ball duck, and Virat Kohli made seven after passing Ricky Ponting as the leading ODI run-scorer against New Zealand. Only Srinath's 4 for 23 in Auckland in 2003 beats Brar's figures for an Indian fast bowler there.

update.new: India won the second ODI by four runs.
update.front: India are a win from the series with three games left.

seconds.headline: Alcaraz beats Ruud 6-4, 6-4 and plays Ben Shelton, who ended his US Open defence, in the Paris final tonight
seconds.short: Carlos Alcaraz beat Casper Ruud 6-4, 6-4 on Saturday to reach his first Paris Masters final, where he plays Ben Shelton on Court Central at 19:30 IST tonight. Shelton beat him in a five-set US Open quarter-final in September. "It is probably one of the most difficult challenges you can face in tennis right now," Alcaraz said.

why.text: A win would give Alcaraz the one big indoor title he lacks, on an eight-match winning run a week before Turin.

more: "Ben is playing great tennis. Last time, it was a hell of a match. But I'm going to enjoy this moment because I was chasing the final here for a long time," said the world No. 3. The US Open was his first tournament after four months out with a wrist injury.

He has lost only one of 16 matches since that defeat, and won in Vienna last week. Only Shelton and Jannik Sinner have matched his six tour-level finals this year, despite the time he missed. Alcaraz beat Ruud in the 2022 US Open final to win his first major and reach world No. 1 for the first time.

update.front: Alcaraz plays for a Paris title tonight against the man who beat him in New York.

stories.headline: Modi spends Diwali with security forces in Bastar and calls it the first Diwali with no district under Naxalism
stories.short: Narendra Modi celebrated Diwali with security personnel in Chhattisgarh's Bastar on Sunday, saying it was the first Diwali in which every district of India was free of Naxalism. "This is the first Diwali when crores of countrymen have overcome the fear of Naxalism. This is an extraordinary achievement," he told them.

why.text: Bastar was the heart of India's longest insurgency, and the government is staking its claim that the war is over.

more: Bastar, once "a land where the menace of Naxalism once prevailed", was seeing a new wave of development, he said, crediting the courage and sacrifice of the security forces. "It belongs to millions of brave men and women like you, our soldiers and security personnel. That is why I have come here today to celebrate Diwali with you."

He said earlier governments had kept the hands of the forces tied and that Naxalite attacks went unanswered, while his government gave them freedom to take decisions on the ground and went after the networks that sustained the insurgency. He warned that while armed Naxals had been wiped out, "dimagi Naxals" still hide among us.

facts.claim: first Diwali with every district free of Naxalism

stories.headline: New Zealand's tight election may leave Qiulae Wong, a politician of less than a year, holding the balance of power
stories.short: Christopher Luxon's centre-right coalition could govern with a majority of just two seats after preliminary counting in Saturday's New Zealand election, but special votes counted by 27 November usually favour the left. That could hand the balance of power to Qiulae Wong, 38, whose centrist Opportunity Party looks set to enter parliament with seven seats.

why.text: India is in New Zealand for a cricket tour and a trade push, and who governs in Wellington decides where that deal goes.

more: Wong, a former sustainable-business consultant, answered a job advertisement to lead the decade-old party in November 2025 and oversaw a rebrand and rapid rise. It has 5.96% of the vote. "It might seem like we've just arrived, that this is an overnight success, but to many in this room, this result has been a long time coming," she told supporters in Auckland.

Opportunity's flagship policy is an annual NZ$19,400 universal basic income for most residents, paid for by a 1.75% annual land tax, along with a simpler income tax. Either Luxon's National party or Labour under Chris Hipkins is expected to try to form a coalition in the coming days or weeks.

stories.headline: Indian Oil will buy its own tankers as spot freight for crude hits $10 a barrel, four times what it pays on charter
stories.short: Indian Oil Corporation's board has approved buying a few crude and LPG carriers and is looking at having ships built in India, finance director Anuj Jain said on its results call. Spot freight rates for crude have reached $8 to $10 a barrel during the Hormuz disruption, against the $2 to $2.50 IOC pays on its time charters.

why.text: Freight and war-risk insurance are now a big part of what India pays for oil, and owning ships is how its biggest refiner plans to cut that.

more: "The country needs oil sector companies to focus more on the shipping area now," Jain said, adding that IOC is examining shipbuilding in India under Make in India. Tenders for the purchases were issued several months ago, and the board has already approved them.

IOC has relied on time-chartered and voyage-chartered ships, and now has three crude carriers and nine LPG vessels on time charter, which have kept its costs down during the crisis. The pressure is even greater for LPG. Last week an Indian seafarer was killed when a vessel was hit off Oman, and US strikes on Iran's Qeshm Island have continued.

facts.on charter: three crude carriers, nine LPG ships

update.new: IOC will buy its own ships as freight soars.
